title: ITIES Detect: presumptive amphetamine detection from cyclic voltammograms at the water|1,2-dichloroethane interface

creators.name: Kwaczyński, Paweł
creators.affiliation: University of Humanities and Economics in Lodz

description: Rule-based analysis of cyclic voltammograms recorded at the polarised water|1,2-dichloroethane interface. The script finds the TPrA+ reference pair, shifts the potential axis so that its midpoint is at -0.091 V, finds the analyte pair and compares the distance between the pair midpoints with 0.350 V. The web application runs the same Python file in the browser with Pyodide; measurement files stay on the user's computer.
